verdicts.reason: Both use the same bad crop of the background: the crucifix, which is the main image, is cut down to a sliver of wood and one silver arm at the left edge. The original's thin frame border is gone, and 'Easter' sits right against the cross upright with almost no left margin. A leaves a large, loose gap between 'Easter' and 'CHURCH SERVICE', so the title and its subtitle don't read as one block. B moves the headline down and groups the two lines more tightly, which makes it slightly better, though it is still not shippable.
